caption:
For anyone who feels far from home tonight

East or west, wherever you turn, there is the Face of Allah. He is All-Encompassing, All-Knowing, so no place is too far and no corner is hidden from Him.

Surah Al-Baqara 2:115

Send this to someone living far from their family.

#allahisnear #faraway #surahbaqarah #muslimabroad

Recitation: Yasser Al-Dosari
